house.description: Children's museums clarified to be eligible to receive children's museum competitive grants from the arts and cultural heritage fund.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; clarifying which children's museums are eligible to receive children's museum competitive grants from the arts and cultural heritage fund; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 129D.17, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 129D.17, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 8.+]

[+Children's museums.+]

[+A state agency or other recipient of an appropriation from the arts and cultural heritage fund that uses the appropriation for a program that awards competitive grants solely to children's museums may award grants only to applicants that meet the requirements of the A52 classification of the National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities used by the Internal Revenue Service, or the analogous code from a successor classification system. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; clarifying which children's museums are eligible to receive children's museum competitive grants from the arts and cultural heritage fund; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 129D.17, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 129D.17, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 8.

Children's museums.

A state agency or other recipient of an appropriation from the arts and cultural heritage fund that uses the appropriation for a program that awards competitive grants solely to children's museums may award grants only to applicants that meet the requirements of the A52 classification of the National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities used by the Internal Revenue Service, or the analogous code from a successor classification system.
additions: A state agency or other recipient of an appropriation from the arts and cultural heritage fund that uses the appropriation for a program that awards competitive grants solely to children's museums may award grants only to applicants that meet the requirements of the A52 classification of the National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities used by the Internal Revenue Service, or the analogous code from a successor classification system.
